summary.name: UberLLM
summary.one_liner: UberLLM is a pay-per-use API gateway that gives one OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible key for LLM, image, video, music and speech models, with each request billed at a below-list price set by third-party sellers.
keywords: one api key for many models
use_cases: Calling Claude, GPT, Gemini or DeepSeek models at lower cost
Generating images, videos or music through one API key
Pointing an existing OpenAI or Anthropic SDK at a cheaper backend
Running Claude Code through a different base URL
Batch media generation with async task polling or webhooks
Comparing model outputs in a playground before integrating
summary.what_it_does: UberLLM exposes a single OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint (https://api.uberllm.dev/v1) for text, image, video, music and speech models. Developers switch models by changing the model id, and the page says requests route to the cheapest healthy seller, with automatic rerouting when a seller is slow or down. Text responses can stream token by token, while image and video jobs return a task to poll or send a webhook when finished. The page says it does not run models itself; sellers serve models through their own provider accounts and set prices below list. Failed requests are not billed, there is no monthly fee, and card top-ups carry a 5.5% + $0.50 fee.
notable: Single key routes to 498 models, billed at the provider's charged price with no UberLLM request fee
Failed requests and generations cost nothing
Claude Code can be pointed at UberLLM with two environment variables
Sellers can list spare provider capacity on a resale marketplace
caveats: Card top-ups cost 5.5% + $0.50 per the page
Prices and availability come from third-party sellers and are shown live, so they can change
Sellers must be authorized to resell access; stolen, shared, free-trial and evaluation keys are prohibited
